usage: Prompt vocabulary for agents. These verbs are not standalone CLI commands.

commands.name: shape
commands.intent: Plan UX and information architecture before code.

commands.name: direction
commands.intent: Create a contextual visual thesis and direction artifact.

commands.name: critique
commands.intent: Review one page or component and rank UX issues.

commands.name: audit
commands.intent: Review accessibility, responsive behavior and performance.

commands.name: polish
commands.intent: Perform a focused final quality pass.

commands.name: distill
commands.intent: Remove complexity that does not help users.

commands.name: bolder
commands.intent: Increase distinctiveness without harming clarity.

commands.name: quieter
commands.intent: Reduce visual competition while preserving hierarchy.

commands.name: colorize
commands.intent: Improve semantic color roles and validate contrast.

commands.name: typeset
commands.intent: Improve type roles, scale, measure and line height.

commands.name: layout
commands.intent: Improve composition, spacing, alignment and density.

commands.name: animate
commands.intent: Add meaningful state feedback and respect reduced motion.

commands.name: adapt
commands.intent: Adapt a target to viewports and input methods.

commands.name: harden
commands.intent: Improve empty, loading, error and edge-case resilience.

commands.name: generate
commands.intent: Generate a component for a named product need.

commands.name: refactor
commands.intent: Refactor existing code while preserving behavior.

commands.name: live
commands.intent: Inspect a local DOM node and export a precise patch.

commands.name: investigate
commands.intent: Research a design/technical question using primary sources.

commands.name: onboard
commands.intent: Improve first-run, setup and empty states.

commands.name: extract
commands.intent: Identify repeated UI patterns worth systematizing.
